sourceCode: _pretenured_setPoint: pt1 point: pt2   origin := (pt1 x min: pt2 x) @ (pt1 y min: pt2 y).   corner := (pt1 x max: pt2 x) @ (pt1 y max: pt2 y)

_pretenured_origin: originPoint corner: cornerPoint   "Answer an instance of me whose corners (top left and bottom right) are	determined by the arguments."   ^ self basicNew        _pretenured_setPoint: originPoint        point: cornerPoint
_pretenured_setDestForm: df   | bb |   bb := df _pretenured_boundingBox.   destForm := df.   clipX := bb left.   clipY := bb top.   clipWidth := bb width.   clipHeight := bb height
_pretenured_setForm: aForm   self reset.   form := aForm.   port := GrafPort _pretenured_toForm: form
_pretenured_getCanvas   "Return a Canvas that can be used to draw onto the receiver"   ^ self defaultCanvasClass _pretenured_on: self
key: newKey value: newValue   "Answer an instance of me with the arguments as the key and value of	the association."   ^ self basicNewTenured key: newKey value: newValue
effectIn: anHGSimulator deltaT: aNumber   self      draw: anHGSimulator      on: anHGSimulator form _pretenured_getCanvas
initialize   "Initialize the receiver."   super initialize.   self      origin: 0 @ 0;      offset: 0 @ 0
